statement_map.email_excerpt: You told us that leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not going to them.
Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it.
You submitted a test lead from your page and confirmed the autoresponder email arrived in your inbox.
We explained that you can verify your sender domain under email domain in settings, so that mails do not go to spam.
